front.head: East End bungalow
intro: This East End bungalow was updated from the foundation up.
The foundation was reworked, leveled and braced, and the wiring, breaker box, plumbing and roof are all new.
The wiring, breaker box, plumbing and roof are all new.
New flooring, trim, paint and lighting run from the living room through the dining area to the open kitchen.
New flooring, trim, paint and lighting run through the front rooms.
The siding is new fiber cement.
The yard is fully fenced, and laundry is inside the house.
Downtown is 3.7 miles away, and Eastwood Park is 1.2 miles from the house.
